annotations.title: Validate JSON against a JSON Schema

description: Validate JSON against a JSON Schema. Use when a task needs to know whether a JSON value satisfies a JSON Schema (2020-12 and draft-07 keywords, local $ref), with the path and reason for every failure, before passing the value to another system. Cost: 1 credit per call.

instance.description: The JSON value to validate, of any type.

schema.description: The JSON Schema, an object or a boolean. Only local $ref is followed; no network reference is fetched.

name: json_schema_validate
